scripts.test:reg: npm run clean:reports && npm run test:dev -- --grep "@reg" && npm run report
scripts.test:func: npm run clean:reports && npm run test:dev -- --grep "@func" && npm run report
scripts.test:smoke: npm run clean:reports && npm run test:dev -- --grep "@smoke" && npm run report
scripts.test:auth: npm run clean:reports && npm run test:dev -- --grep "@auth" && npm run report
scripts.test:api: npm run clean:reports && cross-env TEST_ENV=dev playwright test --config=playwright.api.config.ts --grep "@api" && npm run report
scripts.test:dev:report: npm run clean:reports && npm run test:dev && npm run report:generate && npm run report:open
